rule: Find the single 3x3 4/6 motif (bounding box of the 4s). For every placement of any of its 8 orientations, possibly partly off-grid, where all motif-6s land on in-grid 6s and no in-grid motif-4 position holds 4 or 6, paint colour 4 on the in-grid 4-positions. All other cells are unchanged.

authored_scope: Random scenes use 10..22 per side (fixtures are 12..19; the wider range is a synthetic extension). Explicit sizes are 6..30. Motifs are any spanning 4/6 mask with 3-6 sixes. Six sixes is a synthetic extension; fixtures use 3-5. Each scene has 1-3 copies (1-6 explicit) in all dihedral orientations. Deliberate edge and corner clipping happens in about 35% of random scenes, whenever the motif has an all-4 edge line. Noise is 0/1/6/8 with a per-scene 6 density. Not supported: motifs with fewer than three 6s; motifs larger or smaller than 3x3; copies whose 6s are clipped; overlapping copies; copies overlapping the motif box; deliberately planted blocked decoys.
authored_constraints: Colour 4 appears in the input only inside the fully in-grid motif box; the motif's 4s span all rows and columns.
Motif has at least three 6s and only colours 4/6; noise and fill use only 0,1,6,8.
Every copy keeps all its 6s in-grid and shows at least one in-grid 4-position, so the output always differs from the input.
Copy boxes do not overlap each other or the motif box.
The exact match set computed from the input equals the latent copy list. Extras are broken by recolouring an unprotected 6 or by placing a 6 blocker.
Blocked near-copies (all 6s present, a 4-position holding 6) are broken when they own an unprotected 6.
Fixture replay asserts the motif and copy 6s already exist in the background and that no unlisted match exists.
All retry loops are bounded (200 scene attempts, 60 repair passes, 100 placement tries, 500 motif tries).
